description: STING Visibility Center — corporate baseline presets. Project-scoped presets layer on top from <project>/_BIM_COORD/visibility_presets.json and win by name. Categories may be named by BuiltInCategory ('OST_DuctCurves'); the plugin resolves the id and display name at load, so this file stays readable and Revit-version safe. Token VALUES here are the STING defaults (DISC: A E FLS FP G LV M P S · LOC: BLD1-3 EXT · ZONE: Z01-Z04 · LVL: GF LG B1 L01.. MZ RF XX) — edit them to match your project's codes. A preset may use Hide OR ShowOnly, never both: the two have opposite meanings and a mixed set is rejected with a message.
_excludedCategories_note: BuiltInCategory names left out of the dropdown's category list. These are view-management categories, not model content — 'hide Cameras' is never what anyone means, and on a real model they bury the categories that matter. Grids and Levels are deliberately NOT here: hiding those is a real, common request. A project overrides this by declaring its own 'excludedCategories' in <project>/_BIM_COORD/visibility_presets.json; an explicit empty list there means 'exclude nothing'. Nothing is silently dropped — excluded categories are counted and logged once per scan.

presets.name: Zone isolation
presets.description: Show only the elements in one zone. Edit the ZONE value to the zone you are working in.

presets.name: Hide other zones (saved to view)
presets.description: Persistent version of zone isolation — saved in the view, so it prints and can be pushed onto a view template for a whole sheet package. Hides the zones you are NOT working in; edit the list.

presets.name: Level solo
presets.description: Show only one level's elements. The fastest way to read a congested 3D view. Edit LVL to your level code (GF, L01, B1, LG, MZ, RF).

presets.name: Hide roof and mezzanine
presets.description: Drop the roof and mezzanine out of a 3D or section view so you can see into the occupied floors.

presets.name: Hide below ground
presets.description: Hide basement and lower-ground levels. Edit the list if the project has more than two below-ground levels.

presets.name: QA — unresolved level
presets.description: Show only elements whose level token never resolved (XX) or is blank. These are the elements that will tag wrongly and schedule into the wrong floor — fix them before issue.

presets.name: Building solo
presets.description: Show one building on a multi-building site. Edit LOC (BLD1, BLD2, BLD3).

presets.name: Hide external works
presets.description: Hide everything located outside the buildings (LOC = EXT) — site drainage, external lighting, hardstanding.

presets.name: Discipline solo
presets.description: Show only one discipline's elements — the coordination equivalent of soloing a track. Edit DISC (A, S, M, E, P, FP, FLS, LV, G).

presets.name: Architecture only
presets.description: Show only architectural elements.

presets.name: Structure only
presets.description: Show only structural elements.

presets.name: Architecture + structure
presets.description: The base model MEP coordinates against — architecture and structure, no services.

presets.name: Electrical only
presets.description: Show only electrical elements, including LV distribution.

presets.name: Fire systems only
presets.description: Show only fire protection and fire/life-safety elements — sprinklers, alarms, detection.

presets.name: Hide all MEP
presets.description: Strip every service out of the view, leaving the architectural and structural shell.

presets.name: Hide untagged
presets.description: Hide everything that has no discipline token yet, leaving only tagged work visible.

presets.name: QA — show untagged only
presets.description: The inverse audit: show ONLY elements with no discipline token, so the work still to be tagged is all that is on screen.

presets.name: MEP only
presets.description: Show only mechanical, electrical and public-health categories. Category-based, so it works on an untagged model where the discipline presets cannot.

presets.name: Ceiling void coordination
presets.description: The services that fight for ceiling void space, plus the ceilings themselves — what you want on screen when resolving a tight soffit.

presets.name: Rooms and spaces only
presets.description: Show only Rooms and MEP Spaces — for checking spatial coverage, room bounding and area take-off without the model in the way.

presets.name: Hide annotation clutter
presets.description: Hide tags, dimensions, text and reference planes so the model geometry reads clearly. Model elements are untouched.
